paragraphs: Rav Nechemyah, son of Rav Yehoshua.
In Moed Katan 19b he says, “I found Rav Pappi and Rav Papa sitting and saying ...”; Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Nechemyah, son of Rav Yosef.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The quotation stops after “sitting and saying”; Hyman does not supply the remainder of Rav Pappi and Rav Papa’s statement. The two speakers are kept distinct.

Hyman gives Yehoshua as the father in the heading, but attributes the reading Yosef to דק״ס, conventionally Dikdukei Soferim. The alternative does not replace the heading. Moed Katan 19b follows the printed יט:.
